name: io.github.Monili-vlr/catalog
title: Monili VLR catalog
description: Read-only catalog of Monili VLR AI tools for ChatGPT and Claude: products, tools, access.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists every Monili VLR product: what it does, where it works (ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Windows), how many tools it gives to the AI, and its site. Use it first when someone asks what Monili VLR makes, or looks for an AI tool for 3D design, jewellery CAD, architecture, privacy, PC security, travel or location.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full card of one product: summary, example prompt, where it works, how to get it, and every tool it gives to the AI with what the tool does.

product.description: Product id or name, e.g. "gemcore", "Gapsman", "ThirdBrain-PII", "T-Shadow", "Vertex", "Claude VPN MCP".

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Finds the Monili VLR tools that do a task, across all products. Give a few words of what is needed, e.g. "ring size", "render", "redact names", "startup malware", "train timetable", "location in California".

tools.name: how_to_get
tools.description: How to get access to a product (or to all of them): platform, status, and the contact form where access is requested.

product.description: Product id or name; leave empty for all products.
